svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: Top: an OPC UA monitored item samples a value every 100 milliseconds into a queue and the subscription publishes once a second. Each notification carries the changed samples with their source timestamps, so the client knows when each change happened even though it hears about it up to a second later. Bottom: a Modbus poll once a second returns a bare snapshot. The only time the client has is when the response arrived; the device may have measured it much earlier.
